subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• A 2019 study examined the wing spans of various butterfly species in tropical regions.
• Heliconius melpomene and Morpho menelaus were among the species studied by Dr. Min-Ah Ko.
• Heliconius melpomene butterflies have an average wing span of 6.8 cm.
• Morpho menelaus butterflies have an average wing span of 12.4 cm.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize a difference between the wing spans of the two butterfly species. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: A 2019 study compared the wing spans of various butterfly species found in tropical regions, such as Heliconius melpomene and Morpho menelaus.
choices.B: The butterfly species Heliconius melpomene and Morpho menelaus, both found in tropical regions, were included in a 2019 study that examined their wing spans.
choices.C: Dr. Min-Ah Ko led a research study that determined the average wing spans of butterflies, including those of Heliconius melpomene (6.8 cm) and Morpho menelaus (12.4 cm).
choices.D: A 2019 study found that Heliconius melpomene butterflies had an average wing span of 6.8 cm, whereas Morpho menelaus butterflies were larger, with an average wing span of 12.4 cm.

explanation: Choice D is correct. It contrasts wing spans: Heliconius melpomene averages 6.8 cm while Morpho menelaus averages 12.4 cm.
